tools.name: generate_world_map
tools.description: Draw a world map colouring countries by a number (sales, population, users, visitors by country). Use country names in any common language or ISO 3166 codes (e.g. 'Japan', 'JP', 'JPN'); unmatched names are listed in the result with 'Did you mean' hints. For regions inside one country use generate_co

tools.name: generate_country_map
tools.description: Draw a map of one country with its first-level regions (states, provinces, prefectures, counties, departments) coloured by a number. Works for every country. tools.name: generate_county_map
tools.description: Draw a map of US counties coloured by a number: all of the US, or the counties of one state. Name counties with their state ("Cook, IL", "Los Angeles County, California") or use 5-digit FIPS codes ("17031"). With 'state' set, bare county names are looked up in that state. For states, use generate_co

tools.name: generate_kpi_card
tools.description: Draw 1 to 4 KPI cards as one image: each a big number with its label, optional change since the last period (green when good, red when bad) and an optional sparkline of recent values. For report emails, Slack updates and dashboards in documents. To combine KPI cards with charts in one image use gene

tools.description: Draw a map with labelled dots at given latitude/longitude anywhere in the world (offices, stores, customers, events). Optional 'value' sizes the dots. tools.name: generate_area_chart
tools.description: Draw an area chart: a line chart with the area below filled, for totals or volumes over time (traffic, revenue). Data [{time, value, group?}]; set stack true to stack groups. For plain trends use generate_line_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel lin

tools.name: generate_bar_chart
tools.description: Draw a horizontal bar chart to compare categories, best for long category names or rankings (top 10). Data [{category, value, group?}]; set group or stack true for several series. For vertical bars use generate_column_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/E

tools.name: generate_boxplot_chart
tools.description: Draw a box plot: median, quartiles and outliers of the values in each category, to compare distributions. Data [{category, value, group?}] with one row per observation. For the shape of the distribution use generate_violin_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPo

tools.name: generate_column_chart
tools.description: Draw a vertical column chart to compare values across categories or periods (sales by quarter, users by plan). Data [{category, value, group?}]; set group true for side-by-side series or stack true to stack them. For long labels or rankings use generate_bar_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share

tools.description: Draw a combined column and line chart with two y-axes, for two measures with different units over the same categories (revenue in € as columns, margin in % as a line). Give categories [..] and series [{type: 'column'|'line', data [numbers], axisYTitle?}]. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt

tools.name: generate_fishbone_diagram
tools.description: Draw a fishbone (Ishikawa, cause-and-effect) diagram: the problem as the head, groups of causes as the bones. Data {name: problem, children: [{name: cause group, children: [{name: cause}]}]}. For a plain hierarchy use generate_mind_map. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable

tools.name: generate_flow_diagram
tools.description: Draw a flowchart of a process: steps and decisions joined by arrows. Data {nodes: [{name}], edges: [{source, target, name?}]} where edges refer to node names. For relationships without a direction of flow use generate_network_graph. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable Powe

tools.name: generate_funnel_chart
tools.description: Draw a funnel chart of how many remain at each stage of a process (visitors → sign-ups → purchases), widest first. Data [{category, value}] in stage order. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_histogram_chart
tools.description: Draw a histogram of how raw numbers are distributed (response times, ages, order sizes). Data is a flat list of numbers; binNumber sets how many bins. To compare categories use generate_column_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_line_chart
tools.description: Draw a line chart of values over time (daily users, monthly revenue, prices). Data [{time, value, group?}] with one line per group. For filled volumes use generate_area_chart; for one small chart per group use generate_small_multiples. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable P

tools.name: generate_liquid_chart
tools.description: Draw a liquid-fill gauge showing one percentage as a filled shape (goal progress, capacity used). percent is 0 to 1, e.g. 0.72. For a dial against a maximum use generate_gauge_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_mind_map
tools.description: Draw a mind map: a central topic with branches of subtopics. Data {name, children: [{name, children?}]}. For reporting lines use generate_organization_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_network_graph
tools.description: Draw a network graph of entities (nodes) and their relationships (edges): people, systems, dependencies. Data {nodes: [{name}], edges: [{source, target, name?}]}. For a step-by-step process use generate_flow_diagram. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel lin

tools.name: generate_organization_chart
tools.description: Draw an organization chart of who reports to whom. Data {name, description?, children: [...]} starting from the top person; orient sets horizontal or vertical. For ideas rather than people use generate_mind_map. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_pie_chart
tools.description: Draw a pie chart (or a donut with innerRadius, e.g. 0.6) of the parts of one whole: market share, budget split. Data [{category, value}]; best with 2 to 7 slices. For many categories or comparisons use generate_bar_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Exce

tools.name: generate_radar_chart
tools.description: Draw a radar (spider) chart comparing items on four or more measures (products scored on price, quality, support…). Data [{name: measure, value, group?: item}]. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_sankey_chart
tools.description: Draw a Sankey diagram of flows between stages, with link widths proportional to amounts (budget allocation, user journeys, energy flows). Data [{source, target, value}]. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_scatter_chart
tools.description: Draw a scatter plot of two numeric measures per item to show correlation or clusters (price vs rating). Data [{x, y, group?}]. To size dots by a third measure use generate_more_charts with type bubble. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_treemap_chart
tools.description: Draw a treemap: nested rectangles sized by value, for parts of a whole with a hierarchy (disk usage, spend by department and team). Data [{name, value, children?}]. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_venn_chart
tools.description: Draw a Venn diagram of how sets overlap (customers of product A, B, both). Data [{sets: ['A'] or ['A','B'], value, label?}], one row per set and per overlap. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_violin_chart
tools.description: Draw a violin plot: the shape of the distribution of values in each category. Data [{category, value, group?}] with one row per observation. For medians and quartiles use generate_boxplot_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_waterfall_chart
tools.description: Draw a waterfall chart of how a starting value becomes a final value through gains and losses (profit bridge, budget variance). Data [{category, value, isTotal?}]; positive values go up, negative down, isTotal rows show the running total. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editabl

tools.name: generate_word_cloud_chart
tools.description: Draw a word cloud with words sized by frequency or weight (feedback themes, keywords). Data [{text, value}]. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_spreadsheet
tools.description: Draw a table as an image, or a pivot table when rows/values are given (cross-tabulation, sums by category). Data [{...}] objects with the same fields; rows, columns and values name the fields to pivot. For an Excel file use the Excel link any chart tool returns. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share pa

tools.name: generate_gantt_chart
tools.description: Draw a Gantt chart (a project timeline): one bar per task from its start to its end date, optionally coloured by group or phase. Use for project plans, roadmaps and schedules. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_gauge_chart
tools.description: Draw a gauge (speedometer dial) for one value between a minimum and a maximum, e.g. a score of 72 out of 100. For a percentage as a filled shape use generate_liquid_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_heatmap_chart
tools.description: Draw a heatmap: a grid of cells coloured by value, with x and y categories (e.g. weekday × hour, product × region). For one cell per calendar day use generate_calendar_heatmap. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_calendar_heatmap
tools.description: Draw a calendar heatmap (GitHub-style contribution grid): one cell per day coloured by value. Use for daily activity over weeks or months. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_candlestick_chart
tools.description: Draw a candlestick (OHLC) chart of prices: open, high, low and close for each period. For a simple price trend use generate_line_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.name: generate_bullet_chart
tools.description: Draw a bullet chart: each measure as a bar against its target marker, e.g. KPIs versus goals. For headline numbers with changes use generate_kpi_card. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

tools.description: Team and sharing settings of the connected workspace. operation: list_team; invite_member (args {email}) and remove_member (args {member: user id from list_team}) for the owner only; list_client_pages, create_client_page (args {name, charts: [chart ids]}) and delete_client_page (args {id}) for read-

tools.name: list_chart_versions
tools.description: List the saved earlier versions of a living chart, newest first, as JSON (version number, date, image or page link). Use it before restore_chart_version. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_living_chart, list_my_charts, manage_workspace, list_chart_versions, restore_chart_version · Private data: generate_kpi_card, generate_dashboard, generate_spreadsheet · Public sink: generate_world_map, generate_country_map, generate_county_map, generate_kpi_card, generate_pin_map, generate_dashboard, generate_map_ranking, generate_small_multiples, generate_area_chart, generate_bar_chart, generate_boxplot_chart, generate_column_chart, generate_dual_axes_chart, generate_fishbone_diagram, generate_flow_diagram, generate_funnel_chart, generate_histogram_chart, generate_line_chart, generate_liquid_chart, generate_mind_map, generate_network_graph, generate_organization_chart, generate_pie_chart, generate_radar_chart, generate_sankey_chart, generate_scatter_chart, generate_treemap_chart, generate_venn_chart, generate_violin_chart, generate_waterfall_chart, generate_word_cloud_chart, generate_spreadsheet, generate_gantt_chart, generate_gauge_chart, generate_heatmap_chart, generate_calendar_heatmap, generate_candlestick_chart, generate_bullet_chart, generate_more_charts, create_living_chart, update_living_chart, list_my_charts, add_destination, send_chart_on_update, manage_workspace, schedule_chart.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
